tabs.label: Route tabs

actions.systemOrgHint: The top-most organization cannot be disabled, moved or deleted
actions.tenantTopHint: The top-level organization cannot be disabled, moved or deleted from inside the organization; contact your system administrator if you need this

form.name: Name
form.parentHint: It can be moved under any organization within your management scope, except itself and the organizations below it.
form.logoHint: PNG / JPG / WebP, square recommended, up to 2MB
form.ownerHint: After the transfer, the new owner's administrator grant cannot be revoked, and the owner cannot be removed from the organization or disabled.
form.visibility: Users can see data from organizations below their own
form.visibilityHint: This setting only appears on the top-level organization and applies to the whole organization.

createChild.title: New sub-organization under “{parent}”
createChild.hint: Lightweight entry point: it only creates one child organization.

toggle.disableBody: “{name}” and all of its descendants will be disabled. Users who only belong to disabled organizations will not be able to sign in. You can re-enable it at any time.
toggle.enableBody: Only “{name}” will be enabled; each descendant has to be enabled separately.

delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.body: The data is kept after deletion; the organization just no longer appears in the tree.
delete.blocked: This organization cannot be deleted yet:
delete.useDisableInstead: Use “Disable” instead — it disables the whole subtree and keeps all data.

reasons.OWNS_ROLES: Roles are still owned by it
reasons.HAS_BUSINESS_DATA: Records are still attached to it
reasons.SYSTEM_ORG: This is the top-most organization and cannot be deleted

provision.title: Provision tenant
provision.adminAccountHint: The account is the sign-in identifier; it defaults to the email and can be changed.
provision.modules: Available modules (all selected by default; adjust the tenant's copy later in role management)
provision.modulesHint: “Modules & permissions” and “Data scope” are platform-only and not listed.
provision.note: Provisioning creates the tenant organization, copies the “Tenant administrator” role template, creates the first administrator and wires everything up. An activation email is sent to the administrator, who sets their own password (the link is valid for 7 days).

errors.ORG_NOT_DELETABLE: This organization cannot be deleted; disable it instead.
errors.CROSS_TENANT: The new parent is not under the same top-level organization, so the move was rejected.
errors.CYCLIC_MOVE: An organization cannot be moved underneath one of its own descendants.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This organization does not exist, or is outside your scope.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are invalid; please check and try again.

keepAll.hint: The roles keep working; the data they reach still follows the user's organizations and the list marks them

orgChange.protected: {role} is protected by owner protection and will not be revoked

reasons.NO_REMAINING_SUBTREE_SUPPORT: None of the remaining organizations sits under the role's owning organization

toggle.enableBody: They can sign in to the admin again.
